invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.product_id must reference an existing Product.id
The stock quantity of a product must not go below zero after a sale.
The quantity sold in a sale must be greater than zero.
The sum of all quantities sold for a product must equal the difference between its initial stock quantity and its current stock quantity.
A sale can only be recorded if the product's stock quantity is sufficient to cover the sale quantity.
